verdict.rationale: Solid documents Resources for using server-loaded data as reactive state with Suspense, plus full SSR with streaming, progressive hydration, and isomorphic components. Together these let data fetched during server rendering reach hydrated interactive components. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated async server-component model with an explicit server/client component split. Missing for 10: explicit async server components, a documented server-to-client component data-passing boundary, and hands-on corroboration of the SSR data flow.
